Defined in: core/tokens/motion/frame-budget.ts:17

Animation frame budgets in milliseconds. The site targets high-rate displays: mobile renders at ≥120Hz (8.33ms/frame) and desktop at ≥240Hz (4.16ms/frame). Per-frame JS work (rAF callbacks, pointermove handlers that touch visual state, tick math) must complete inside these ceilings — anything heavier routes through worker/WASM/GPU paths per the perf-compute-offload conventions.
